create_pwil_config: create a PWILConfig dataclass instance with custom alpha and beta reward function parameters
configure_replay_buffer_transitions: configure the number of transitions to fill the replay buffer for pretraining
set_distance_computation_options: set whether to use actions alongside observations when computing distance metrics
create_demonstrations_container: create a PWILDemonstrations dataclass holding an iterator of transitions and episode length
review_pwil_config_defaults: review the default PWILConfig values matching the PWIL publication experiment setup
